tenderSchedule.title: BIAAPA VEHICLE TENDER
tenderSchedule.locationName: Bangalore International Airport Area Planning Authority

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Agency should not have been block listed by any organization in the State of Karnataka for any reason whatsoever.
Each firm shall submit only one tender
The firm shall be responsible for all the costs with the preparation, submission and opening of tenders

The tender shall remain valid for a period not less than 90 days after the date of opening of tenders. A tender with a validity of less than 90 days shall be treated as non-responsive. If a tenderer withdraws his tender during the validity of the tender then EMD shall be forfeited
At any time prior to the date and time of submission of the tenders, the employermay issue any amendments to this tender document
The service provider shall furnish, as part of its tender, EMD as specified
The Earnest Money Deposit is required to protect the employer against the risk of the firms conduct which would warrant the securitys forfeiture
The Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 36,000/- (Thirty six Thousand Only) shall denominate in Indian rupees and shall be paid in the e-procurement portal using the following payment modes
The service provider shall provide details of the service provider in the format at Annexure-1
Attested copy of Registration from appropriate Authority from GOK as travel agency.
Attested copy of Certificate of Registration in the GST
Proof for owning at least 5 vehicles in the name of Contractor

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The service provider shall provide details of the service provider in the format at Annexure-1
